Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely assumed the target series was The Good Wife and its network CBS without first disambiguating from the spin-off The Good Fight, where Mamie Gummer also played Nancy Crozier (which aired on CBS All Access/Paramount+). This unverified assumption risked leading to the wrong network and the Planner then fixated on IMDb for a second citation despite repeated timeouts instead of promptly switching to an alternative authoritative source, leaving the answer unconfirmed.
